loader_browser.scope: Maintained loading shell and real SVG/browser animation matrices with mocked engine startup.

comparison_method: Current and preserved previous mascot scripts, stage joints and textures rendered natively in matching 280 px slots. Idle is reduced motion; crouch is 0.18 seconds; shared stretch is 50 percent. No pixel retouching.
limitations: Frozen native poses and Chromium/WebKit checks; no physical-device testing or audio review
Full game build validation is recorded by the parent UI task
